_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/s14-deny-stops-batch.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-20 (unattended run 4).

features.description: Approve+Deny in one resume executes nothing: the approved tool is never called and the run halts.
Deny+Approve is the same; neither the answer map's order nor the transcript's call order changes it.
One Deny withholds every Approve in a batch of three or more.
A withheld call still gets a tool result on its own tool_call_id, carrying status not_executed and the person's own answer.
The denied call's own tool result is byte-identical to today's denied record.
After a mixed batch the run's terminal shape is what a Deny produces today: output None, iterations 0, no further model call.
Single-question behaviour is byte-identical for Approve, Deny and free text.
Approve-only behaviour is unchanged: two Approves execute both tools and the run continues.
Free-text-only behaviour is unchanged: Approve beside free text executes the approved one, redirects the other, and the run continues.
A pending call on a tool that does not require confirmation resolves exactly as today, even in a denied batch.
The streaming resume withholds identically and emits the same ToolEnded events and Done result.
_invoke, _resolve_confirmation, _confirmation_question and _has_denial are byte-identical to veyqon, and upstream's TestAgentConfirmation is green and unmodified.
